info.title: VEDO Core REST API

get.description: Returns a paginated list of ontologies the authenticated user has access to.

post.description: Deprecated: under the 1:1 Project ↔ Ontology model, an Ontology is created implicitly when its Project is created via POST /api/v1/projects. This endpoint is retained only for the legacy standalone-import flow and will be removed in a follow-up after the deprecation window.

get.description: Returns full ontology details including counts of classes, properties, and individuals.

put.description: Updates an existing ontology's label, description, or IRI.

delete.description: Deletes an ontology and all associated classes, properties, and individuals.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of classes in an ontology. Supports text search and parent filter.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Full-text search query against class labels and comments

parameters.name: parent_id
parameters.description: Filter by parent class ID (returns direct children)

post.description: Creates a new class in an ontology.

get.description: Returns full class details including hierarchy breadcrumb, property count, and individual count.

put.description: Updates an existing class's label, comment, parent, or IRI.

delete.description: Deletes a class. Fails if the class still has subclasses or individuals.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of properties. Can be filtered by type (object or datatype).

post.description: Creates a new property (object or datatype) in an ontology.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of individuals. Can be filtered by class.

parameters.name: class_id
parameters.description: Filter by class ID (returns individuals of that class)

post.description: Creates a new individual of the specified class in an ontology.

Execute a read-only SPARQL query against an ontology. Mutation queries (INSERT, DELETE) are rejected.

A mandatory LIMIT of 1000 is enforced if no LIMIT clause is present.

Execute a read-only CYPHER query against an ontology. Mutation queries are rejected.

A mandatory LIMIT of 1000 is enforced if no LIMIT clause is present.

get.description: Returns the OpenAPI 3.1 specification for this API.
Returns a paginated list of groups. Supports text search.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Full-text search query against group labels

post.description: Creates a new group within the organization hierarchy.

get.description: Returns full group details including children and member count.

put.description: Updates an existing group's label, description, or parent.

delete.description: Deletes a group. Fails if the group still contains projects or subgroups.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of direct child groups.
Returns a paginated list of members in a group.

post.description: Adds a user as a member of a group with the specified role.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of projects the authenticated user has access to.

post.description: Creates a new project within a group. Under the 1:1 Project ↔ Ontology model, this also creates the paired Ontology atomically.

get.description: Returns full project details.

put.description: Updates an existing project's label or description.

delete.description: Deletes a project and all associated ontologies.

put.description: Moves a project to a different group.

target_group_id.description: Target group ID to move the project to

post.description: Creates a copy of the project (with its paired Ontology) in the user's workspace. The new project gets an upstream_project_id link to the source. Fork is private by default; the caller becomes Owner.

schema.description: Empty body — source ID is in the path. Use Idempotency-Key header.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of members with access to a project.

post.description: Adds a user as a member of a project with the specified role.

put.description: Updates the role of a project member. Cannot remove the last Owner.

delete.description: Removes a member from a project. Cannot remove the last Owner.

get.description: Returns the current visibility level of a project.

put.description: Sets the visibility level of a project.

get.description: Returns a list of access policies for a project.

post.description: Creates a new access policy for a project.

delete.description: Deletes an access policy from a project.

get.description: Returns full property details including domain, range, and functional flag.

put.description: Updates an existing property's label, type, domain, range, or functional flag.

delete.description: Deletes a property. Fails if the property is still in use by any individual.

get.description: Returns full individual details including class, properties, and relations.

put.description: Updates an existing individual's label, class, or IRI.

delete.description: Deletes an individual from an ontology.

get.description: Exports an ontology in a specified format (RDF/XML, Turtle, JSON-LD, OWL/XML).

content.description: Serialized ontology in the requested format

post.description: Imports an ontology from a file in a supported format (RDF/XML, Turtle, JSON-LD, OWL/XML). Merges into the existing ontology unless `replace=true`, which replaces all existing content.
Creates a new commit in the versioning graph, capturing all uncommitted changes to the ontology.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of commits for an ontology, optionally filtered by branch.
Returns commit details including parent SHA, message, and author.
Returns the changes introduced by a commit (added/modified/removed axioms).

post.description: Sets the active workspace to the state at the specified commit. Uncommitted changes are stashed.
Creates a new commit that reverts the ontology to the state at the specified commit. Returns the new rollback commit.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Commit ID or SHA to rollback to

post.description: Creates a new branch from the specified commit or the current HEAD.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of branches for an ontology.
Returns branch details including head SHA.

delete.description: Deletes a branch. The default branch cannot be deleted.

post.description: Makes the specified branch the active branch for the workspace.
Merges the source branch into the target branch, producing a merge commit on the target.

conflicts.description: Conflicts encountered during merge (empty array for clean merges)

path.description: Ancestor group labels from root to this group

upstream_project_id.description: ID of the upstream Project if this is a fork, null otherwise

forks_count.description: Number of forks created from this Project

scope.description: Scope of the membership: group or project

RoleEnum.description: Permission hierarchy: Guest (read-only) < Reporter (read + comment) < Developer (read/write) < Maintainer (manage members) < Owner (full control)

VisibilityLevel.description: private: only explicit members; internal: all org members; public: anyone

actions.description: List of actions this policy applies to (e.g., view, edit, delete, manage)

subjects.description: List of subject IDs this policy applies to (users or groups)

parent_id.description: Optional parent group ID for nested groups

effect.description: Whether this policy allows or denies the specified actions

actions.description: Actions this policy applies to (e.g., view, edit, delete, manage)

subjects.description: Subject IDs this policy applies to (users or groups)

CreateOntologyRequest.description: Deprecated: under the 1:1 Project ↔ Ontology model, an Ontology is created implicitly when its Project is created via POST /api/v1/projects. This request is retained only for the legacy standalone-import flow.

iri.description: Optional base IRI for the ontology

parent_id.description: Optional parent class ID for taxonomy

type.description: Object properties link individuals to individuals; datatype properties link individuals to literals

range.description: Range class ID (object) or XSD datatype (datatype)

is_functional.description: If true, the property is functional (max 1 value per subject)

content.description: Ontology content in the specified format

replace.description: If true, replace all existing content; if false (default), merge

parent_sha.description: Optional parent commit SHA; if omitted, uses current branch HEAD
Parent commit SHA (empty for the initial commit)

from_sha.description: Optional starting commit SHA; defaults to current HEAD

is_default.description: True if this is the default branch
